content: Taa ǝlbǝg maraw tǝ aghwaa
Nǝghgha ba nǝ Yesu kǝ dzahava uudah baɗyaka, kaa dagat kǝ iin damma ghwaa, cǝhura kǝ iina. Kaa ba dagau kǝ mbǝrzahaan da vakaana.
Ngal farzha kǝ iin tsagtǝr dǝgita.
Barka

content.text: “Ar dǝ bark nǝ lii sǝrgasǝrg kǝ hǝtsǝgalhǝtsǝgaatǝr ma gata Daadamazhigǝla,
Ar dǝ bark nǝ lii dǝ badzǝga rǝviɗmahuuɗa,
aɗaba ar da gwigaan kǝ duniya.
Ar dǝ bark nǝ lii kǝma ɓa dǝgiti naag Daadamazhigǝla,
Ar dǝ bark nǝ lii mara zhuwadaala,
Ar dǝ bark nǝ lii caɗaɗ nǝ ǝrviɗmahuda,
aɗaba ar da nǝghǝganǝhǝg kǝ Daadamazhigǝla.
Ar dǝ bark nǝ lii fa gabǝra,
aɗaba da ɗahvǝtǝrɗahǝg dǝ zarha Daadamazhigǝla.
Ar dǝ bark nǝ lii hǝɓa dlaɗ kwakyarvad ɓa hɛrǝrra,

content: “Am dǝ bark nǝ uurama, akwama ar ɗaava kuram nǝ uudaha, ar vǝlkur kǝ dlaɗa, dlaɓa ar ɓagkura kǝ dǝga kǝlaadǝrah shahshah mbakyarvad kaiya.
Dlayamdlaiga am hwaɗag ba vaivaiya, mbakyarvad am da tlǝkǝnatlǝg kǝ dǝgshigaru baɗyak ma ghǝrazhigǝla. Aɗaba vǝlartǝr bandkwah nǝ uudah kǝ dlaɗ kǝ tlayanngahi sarǝv lakuti kǝskurama.
Iizha ard paraka
“Kuram nǝ iizha duniya. Akwama maadlai nashnash nǝ iizh biya, da gwiya gwivdaa ndar nǝ nashnashani? Maadlai tlǝraan biya, bamma ɗivda dagala, hapǝna nǝ uudaha.
“Kuram parak duniya. Akwama favafǝg nǝ kǝs tǝ gavala shiɓvǝna biya.
Maay mbiyav nǝ kaara jahuramba humbvara kǝghai biya, bamma hǝrtǝvǝt tǝ dǝga hǝrtǝgaan vakavaki da ba parakrak kǝ uudahi hǝnnyah baɗǝma.
Bandkwah dlaɓa, parakaruwa aandz ba pǝripǝri tǝvuukwa uudaha, kiyava nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ dǝgitah marawi am ɓag nǝ uurama, ar da fǝgaarafǝg kǝ Daadaruwi ma ghǝrazhigǝla.
Tsag tǝghǝr kǝ adzahadzaha
“Tlatlam bi taakiya sanhi mbakyarvad ǝn kalarwut kǝ Adzahadzah Musa ard tsaga tlayanngah nai biya, sanhi mbakyarvad ǝn righanta.
Ba jiirjiir wan tagkurtaga, lakuti ghyǝng nǝ zhigǝla ard haaya, maay nǝ dǝgit aanji ba hǝɗikǝn ma vindǝga Adzahadzaha Muus kwada nig biya, bamma righavantrighǝg baɗǝmma.

Mbakyarvad kwaha baɗǝm daddakwa kǝladakǝlǝg aanji ba pal ma adzahadzahahaan hǝɗikǝnna, tsagtǝru dlaɓ kǝ kǝla adzahadzahahaan kǝ uudaha, da ɗahav nǝ iin daddakwa ǝnkykwah ma tlǝkǝsǝra ghǝrazhigǝla. Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa gatǝgaan kǝ adzahadzahiina, dlaɓa tsagartsag kǝ uudaha, da ɗahav nǝ iin dǝ uud maamal ma tlǝkǝsǝra ghǝrazhigǝla.
Ən tagkurtaga, akwama jamtǝruubi kǝ lii tsaga adzahadzaha Muus ard Farisah dǝ jiir biya, am dǝgaa bi damma tlǝkǝsǝra ghǝrazhigǝl biya.
Tsag tǝghǝr kǝ nguɗa ǝrviɗya
“Cinngamacinng ndza tagavtǝrdatag kǝ daadijaharu taakiya, ‘Tsǝbi kǝ shifǝg biya, baɗǝm daddakwa tsǝga shifǝga, da tǝvartǝg nǝ shariya.’

Aiciya ǝn tagkurtaga, baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa nguɗa ǝrviɗmahuɗ dǝ zǝraabaana, da tǝvartǝg nǝ shariya. Daddakwa ɗahgarva zǝraabaan taakiya maay nǝ dǝgiti agha tuukvakai biya, da lanngav damma guda ta shariya, dlaɓa daddakwa ɗahgarva zǝraabaan dǝ dlaga, dlaiyaan ɓǝlǝvdǝm damma kaara faiya.
“Kwakyarvad kwaha, akwamagha ɗiya baiku tǝ bagadiya kyulǝga, kaa dzamnadzamǝg kǝskǝgh taakiya hǝkyakahǝkyig nǝ zǝraabagh ma ǝrviɗmahaɗaana,
faffǝg kǝ baikuwaghǝn tǝvuukwa bagadi ndana, dǝga agha ɓaga kǝ gabǝrǝr dǝ zǝraabagh bazǝngwa. Ka sagau kǝskǝgh da ɗiya baikuwagha.

“Akwama da ɗiya ghunjagh nǝ uudana, ɓag kǝ gabǝrǝr dǝ iin tǝ watswats tǝghǝrdǝg lakuti damma guda ta shari. Akwama maay ǝndkwah biya, da langaklang davak alkali, alkali dlaɓa da langaklang davak yaa dela, ar ɓǝlkadǝm ma guda bǝrfina.
Bak jiira wan tagaktaga, lakuti sǝkadasǝg nǝ uud vaakwaha, bamma pǝlghapǝlǝg kǝ kwaɓi gatak nǝ uud baɗǝmma.
Tsag tǝghǝr kǝ ɓa gwaragwara
“Cinngamacinng ndza tagavdatag taakiya, ‘Ɓagam bi kǝ gwaragwar biya.’
Aiciya ǝn tagkurtag, baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa vazǝna dǝkhǝra, dlaɓa kaa kǝmgaan kǝ iina, ɓagaaɓag kǝ gwaragwar dǝ vakai ma ǝrviɗmahuɗaana.
Akwama fǝkaa kǝ ɓa haip nǝ gyiya dǝvaakaffagha, tǝdatǝɗǝga agha ɓǝldana. Ngulǝm maay ba nǝ uuɓiya vǝghagh pal tǝghǝr kwada ɓǝlǝvdǝm nǝ vǝghagh baɗǝm damma kaara faiya.
Akwama fǝkaa kǝ ɓa haip nǝ dǝvaakaffagha, ghwudaghudǝga agha ɓǝldana. Ngulǝm maay ba nǝ uuɓiya vǝghagh pal tǝghǝr kwada ɓǝlǝvdǝm nǝ vǝghagh baɗǝm damma kaara faiya.
Tsag tǝghǝr kǝ tagwavǝgh dǝ uusa
“Tagavdatag dlaɓ taakiya, ‘Daddakwa tagwavatagw dǝ uusaana, barari ghudara kǝ kakaɗa tagwavǝgh dǝ iina.’
Aiciya dǝgiti ǝn tagkurnaiya in taakiya, akwama tagwavatagw nǝ uudan dǝ uusaan kwakyarvad haipa gwaragwar biya, fadǝmfǝg ma ɗuula ɓa gwaragwara. Baɗǝm daddakwa kǝsguukǝsǝga, ɓa ba gwaragwar dǝ iina.
Tsag tǝghǝr kǝ zangwaɗǝga
“Gwaastaana, cinngamacing tagavtǝratag kǝ daadijaharu taakiya, ‘Kǝldabi kǝ lanngiyagh biya, bamma agha righant kǝ langiyi tǝghara nǝnng kǝ Yaazhigǝla.’
Aiciya dǝgiti ǝn tagkurnaiya in taakiya, zambi kǝ ngwaɗǝg ba linnglinng biya, aanji dǝ ghǝrazhigǝl biya aɗaba vaka ndzǝgana Daadamazhigǝla.
Zambi dlaɓ kǝ ngwaɗǝg dǝ haay biya, aɗaba vaka fa shiga Daadamazhigǝla, bi dǝ Wurshalima aɗaba iin nǝ kǝssa Tlǝkǝs ɗyaka.
Zǝbi dlaɓ kǝ ngwaɗǝg dǝ ghǝragh biya aɗaba agha nǝdalbi kǝ guja ghǝragh aanji pall kǝ maɗukwa bi gyangw biya.
Dǝgiti ɓagaaɓaga kǝ maraw kǝ taga iin taakiya, ‘Aana,’ bi ‘Əndkwah biya’, majuujig ma kwana, aasǝgal vak shatanaha.
Tsag tǝghǝr kǝ ɓagar hɛrrǝr kǝ tlǝghuma
“Cinngamacinng tagavdatag taakiya, ‘Gyiya dlakulva gyiya, tlǝrɗ dlaɓa dlakulva tlǝrɗa.’
Dǝgiti ǝn tagkur naiya, akwama naa ɓa dǝgit ghwaɗ nǝ uudan tǝ kǝgha, ɓagarbi kǝ uushav biya, ma ɓǝlakaɓǝlǝg nǝ uudan kǝ mahupeng tǝ uumǝla dǝvaakaffa, agha guyarant ghyaba kwah palla.
Akwama ɗiyakaaɗiig nǝ uudan kǝ ghunnj kwakyarvad kǝskava kǝ angyuwagha, agha vǝlar baz amugdiyagha.
Akwama fakaafǝg nǝ gwarǝɗ kǝ dagala mil palla, dǝgdagal ǝmtaɗ dǝ iin kǝ dǝga mil buwa.
Akwama ghalaaghalǝg nǝ uudan kǝ dǝgit vakagha, agha vǝlara. Dlaɓa ma sǝghǝvsǝg nǝ uudan sa kǝla gǝmau vakagha, piyarda biya.
Waig kǝ tlǝghumagha
“Cinngamacinng tagavdatag taakiya, ‘Waig kǝ zǝraabagha, agha ɗuwant kǝ tlǝghumagha.’
Aiciya, ǝn tagkurtaga, wayamwaig kǝ tlǝghumaharuwa, dzǝgwamtǝrdzǝgw kǝ zhigǝl kǝ lii vǝlkur dlaɗa

Tǝdvad ɓakwan wam da nǝg nǝ uuram kǝ zarha Daadaru kwama ghǝrazhigǝla, kwa fǝgara kǝ faci kǝ ɓa parakrakǝr tǝghǝr kǝ yaa dadda jiira ard lii ɓa kǝlaadǝra, hyitǝrhyig dlaɓ kǝ yu kǝ yaa dadda jira ard yaa dadda kǝlaadǝra.
Akwamam waiya ba lii waiya kuram nǝ uurama, auci nǝ dǝgshigi am da tlǝkǝna nǝ uurami? Aanji lii dzaha hadam ndakwi ar ɓagaan bandkwana.
Akwamam tagtǝr bak zaraabaharu nǝ uuram kǝ uusa, auci gǝrgǝraru dǝ kyalma uudahi? Aanji kǝrdiyah ndakwi ar ɓagaan bandkwaha.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, namalnǝg kǝ yaa dadda jiira band Daadaru kwama ghǝrazhigǝla.
